# Isoclad

> UK's largest independent manufacturer of fire-rated and insulated composite panels for commercial, industrial, and construction applications.

Isoclad specializes in high-performance composite panel systems including fire-rated panels (Firestop range), thermal insulation panels (Thermocore range), and non-combustible linings. The company offers comprehensive services from design and manufacturing through technical support and training, serving projects across the UK and internationally.

## Key Topics

- Composite Panels
- Fire-Rated Panels
- Insulated Panels
- Firestop 10
- Firestop 12
- Thermocore 35
- Thermocore 40
- PIR Insulation
- Non-Combustible Linings
- Thermal Sandwich Panels
- UK Manufacturing
- Building Materials
- Panel Ancillaries & Flashings
- Technical Support
- BES 6001 Certification

## Core Products

- [All Panel Products](https://www.isoclad.co.uk/products): Complete product catalog of fire-rated, insulated composite panels and ancillaries.
- [Firestop 10 Fire-Rated Panel](https://www.isoclad.co.uk/products/firestop-10-fire-rated-panel): Firestop 10 fire-rated panel product details for industrial, retail applications.
- [Firestop 12 Fire-Rated Panel](https://www.isoclad.co.uk/products/firestop-12-fire-rated-panel): Firestop 12 fire-rated panel system with exceptional fire performance and durability.
- [Thermocore 35 Insulated Panel](https://www.isoclad.co.uk/products/thermocore-35-thermal-sandwich-panel): Thermocore 35 thermal sandwich panel for cold stores and cleanrooms with PIR insulation.
- [Thermocore 40 Insulated Panel](https://www.isoclad.co.uk/products/thermocore-40-insulated-panel): Thermocore 40 premium insulated panel for cold rooms, food facilities and cleanrooms.
- [Non-Combustible Lining Panel](https://www.isoclad.co.uk/products/non-combustible-panel): Non-combustible panel solutions for industrial, commercial and high-use environments.
- [Ancillaries & Flashings](https://www.isoclad.co.uk/products/ancillaries-flashings-2): Ancillaries and flashings manufactured at North Shields facility for project finishing.

## Applications & Solutions

- [Applications Overview](https://www.isoclad.co.uk/applications): High-performance construction solutions with fire and insulation-rated composite panels.
- [Commercial Building Cladding](https://www.isoclad.co.uk/cladding-for-commercial-buildings): Commercial building cladding solutions for shops and retail centres with fire safety.
- [Internal Panel Systems](https://www.isoclad.co.uk/applications/internal-panel-systems): Insulated and fire-rated panels for internal systems with Rockwool and PIR cores.
- [Fire-Rated Hoarding Panels](https://www.isoclad.co.uk/applications/hoarding-panels): Fire-rated hoarding panels for quick, durable construction site installations.
